items.name: Readability
items.evidence: Names follow the codebase (`d`, `e`, `sh`, `cs`), but `ShapeIndex.decode` is a ~130-line block with almost no comments, and the wire format is never documented. The docstrings just repeat the name: "Encode encodes the ShapeIndex."

items.name: Maintainability
items.evidence: `ShapeIndex.decode` runs past 100 lines, which caps this at bad. Encode/Decode were put in shapeindex.go, not the required dedicated shapeindex_encode.go. `encode` goes through `es.Encode(e.w)` and builds a second encoder for each shape. The cleanup reset is copy-pasted inside `Decode`.

items.name: Robustness
items.evidence: Counts, cell order, shape refs and edge IDs are all bounds-checked. Gaps: `maxEdgesPerCell` is not validated, and duplicate or negative shape IDs are accepted. Large slices and maps are allocated up front before any data is read (`make([]CellID, numCells)` for up to 10M cells, `newClippedShape(..., numEdges)` for up to 10M edges).

items.name: Existing encodings and Shape interface unchanged
items.name_zh: 既有编码格式与 Shape 接口不变
items.evidence: Existing tags (1-5) are untouched. The new `typeTagLoop = 6` and `typeTagLaxLoop = 7` sit below `typeTagMinUser`. Existing Polygon/Polyline encodings are reused unchanged, and the Shape interface gains no methods. The new Encode/Decode methods only add to the API.
